reason: RESOLVED: 10 tests in TestEnvBlocklistScrubbing prove (a) all 28 ENV_BLOCKLIST vars are scrubbed by scrub_environment, (b) sanitize_env_for_subprocess does not leak blocked vars, (c) CI defaults (CI=true, NONINTERACTIVE=1, LC_ALL, GIT_PAGER, PAGER) are set, (d) TERM defaults to 'dumb' when not pre-existing, (e) extra vars are merged, (f) missing keys are no-op, (g) non-blocklisted vars are preserved.
DEFERRED: Requires adversarial telemetry-disabled degradation test (empty JSON observability, zero-row DuckDB projection). Non-critical for P0 tool-invocation hardening batch.

RESOLVED: 12 tests in TestBinaryFileRejection prove (a) is_likely_binary() detects PNG magic bytes, ELF header, null bytes, high non-ASCII ratio; (b) returns False for plain text, empty content, text with tabs/newlines, Python source; (c) is_binary_extension() rejects known binaries (.png, .exe, .so etc.) and permits text extensions (.py, .txt etc.); (d) ReadFile tool raises ToolError('appears to be binary') for binary extensions (.pdf) and binary content (PNG header in .txt file).

RESOLVED: 6 tests in TestSymlinkTraversalRejection prove (a) resolve_safe_path resolves inside workspace correctly, (b) rejects absolute paths outside workspace, (c) rejects symlink targets outside workspace, (d) rejects symlinks to /etc/passwd, (e) accepts relative paths inside workspace, (f) rejects .. traversal outside workspace.

RESOLVED: 12 tests across 4 classes prove (a) unparseable/truncated JSONL lines detected as malformed_json, (b) duplicate sequence numbers and duplicate event_ids detected, (c) missing required fields (event_id, sequence, event_name, created_at) detected, (d) check_ledger_integrity() added to rig_relay/coordination/store.py as production detection function, (e) valid ledger passes integrity check. All real-artifact sabotage tests with real temp JSONL files.

RECLASSIFIED POST-RC-DEFERRED: Runtime feral subprocess accountability (timeout, cancel, partial output, process death) is an RC dogfood requirement. User has reclassified this from deferred to required. Tests in progress at tests/runtime/test_feral_subprocess_accountability.py.

RESOLVED: 5 tests in TestReleaseGateExitCode prove (a) malformed blocker JSONL → exit code 1 + verdict FAIL, (b) missing evidence path → exit code 1 + verdict FAIL, (c) forbidden Markdown evidence → exit code 1 + verdict FAIL, (d) valid gate without blockers → exit code 0 + verdict PASS, (e) valid HOLD with truthful blockers → exit code 0 + verdict BLOCKED. Validator enhanced with explicit verdict field (PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL) to distinguish structural failure from legitimate blocked gate state.

RESOLVED: 11 tests in TestDangerousPatternDetection prove (a) $() command substitution detected, (b) backtick execution detected, (c) env var injection (PATH=/evil:$PATH) detected, (d) LD_PRELOAD injection detected, (e) python3 -c inline code execution detected, (f) perl -e inline code execution detected, (g) backslash-escaped paths detected, (h) single backtick in safe echo is not flagged, (i) plain ls -la is safe, (j) safe pipe chains (cat|grep|wc) pass, (k) dangerous pipes (env|sh) trigger warnings.

RESOLVED: 6 tests in TestSensitivePathBlocking prove (a) cat with sensitive path in command triggers NEVER permission, (b) second sensitive pattern also blocked, (c) tail on sensitive path also blocked, (d) non-sensitive path not blocked, (e) command without sensitive path passes.

RESOLVED: Duplicate completion detection proven. Supervisor yields exactly one terminal event per invocation (completion, failure, timeout, command-not-found). Async generator is exhausted after terminal event — second anext() raises StopAsyncIteration. Lease state check at entry blocks PENDING, RELEASED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, FAILED leases. Minimal production fix added: in-memory lease status set to RELEASED after execution to close the persistent-store-only release gap. Trace span end_span called exactly once per invocation on all code paths (success, failure, timeout, command-not-found). 18 sabotage tests across 3 classes.

RESOLVED: 4 tests in TestStaleEvidenceDetection prove (a) validation run with stale source_commit (≠ HEAD) detected as error, (b) phase marked 'passing' with stale source_commit detected as error, (c) current evidence (matching HEAD) not flagged, (d) non-git environment gracefully degrades (no false positives). check_stale_evidence() added to validator; stale evidence detection wired into run_validation(). Stale evidence is an ERROR (not warning) because claiming RC readiness on stale evidence is dangerous.
